card.name: Fraction bars in dosing formulas
card.fires_on: Long runs of dash or line characters drawn as the fraction bar in a written formula, between the numerator and the denominator such as 72 x serum creatinine. Also dotted leader lines in tables.

modes.label: Fraction bar in formula
modes.description: Long dash line separating numerator from denominator in creatinine clearance or dose calculation formulas.

modes.label: Dotted leader in table
modes.description: Row of dots or ellipsis leading to a value in a results table.

card.plain: It fires on the long line drawn under the top part of a written formula, such as the creatinine clearance calculation, just before the bottom part.
